[Verse 1]
I hold a thousand tangled threads,
Every beating heart and fragile plan,
All the people that I mentor,
All the ones who say, “You lead us if you can.”
Every system that we try to build,
Every promise that we try to keep,
Every user in the silence,
Every teammate losing sleep.
[Pre-Chorus]
When the lines all start to blur,
I see how every fracture spreads,
Every ripple through the trust,
Every weight on weary heads.
[Chorus]
‘Cause everything connects.
I see the chain from one small crack
To how it lands inside their chests.
I don’t raise my voice for power,
I don’t push just to be right.
I’m just carrying the picture
Of the cost when we lose sight.
They hear fury in my questions,
But it’s care inside my chest.
I’m not angry, I’m invested-
And everything connects.
[Verse 2]
I feel the years stacked in the room,
How they echo into future nights,
All the history in our choices,
Where the work and all our lives collide.
Every lesson I’ve been learning,
Every fix I’ve tried to route,
Every doc and quiet late night
Turned to maps I can’t tune out.
[Bridge]
I want guardrails built from care,
I want clarity like air,
So the ones who hold the work
Feel the freedom to repair.
I want ownership as shelter,
Where they’re strong enough to choose,
Where expectations drawn in light
Mean less trust they have to lose.
I keep stitching all these pieces,
People, futures, company,
And the heaviest part of caring
Is how alone it feels to be.
[Final Chorus]
‘Cause everything connects.
I’m not asking you to agree,
Just to look at what comes next.
It’s not one complaint or project,
It’s the weight of all these ties.
When the picture gets reduced,
To one ticket in your mind,
I feel several layers deeper,
Living downstream of the lines.
So I keep turning pain to language,
Till my strength is all but spent-
I’m not angry, just exhausted,
By the life inside this meant.
If you listen past my volume,
Past the tasks and all the stress,
You would hear a quiet whisper:
I love this more, not less.
I keep trying to connect it-
Every person, past, and next.
And the reason it’s so hard to
Let it go… is everything connects.
